notes.title: Friendship with Benefits 1.2 Final Climax Update!
notes.content:
To celebrate a successful launch, I am releasing a [b]completely free update which adds 12 new sex scenes to the game[/b]!

[list]
[*] [b]+3 Romanceable Girls
[*] +12 new Sex Scenes
[*] Free! [/b]
[/list]
However, these twelve new scenes are being introduced in a unique way. Instead of having obvious new routes which feature these scenes, they've instead been hidden among the world of Arcadia and can be found by exploring the world.

In total, this update adds 13 secrets for you to find, and here are clues to help you find them:

[i]
Secret 1: It's time to go werewolf hunting, but we need a +1 to help us out.
Secret 2: What's up with that Bunny, anyway?
Secret 3: Did you know there are actually two dragons?
Secret 4: This is what happens when you get drunk and sleep around too much.
Secret 5: Déjà vu with Honeycrisp.
Secret 6: Cream has a surprise for you.
Secret 7: Someone has another set of lingerie they want to try with you.
Secret 8: This girl is surprisingly flexible. Did you know she used to be a ballerina?
Secret 9: I'm aerodynamic. Big breasts just get in the way. 
Secret 10: At the break of Dawn.
Secret 11: Melody finally unleashes her inner femdom. Question is, where?
Secret 12: Working with a Succubus is probably a bad idea.
Secret 13: Talk to the cured werewolf. But, who is it?
[/i]

[list]
[*] All secrets are one time events! However, you can re-experience them using the Crystal Ball and the Art Gallery.
[*] You can keep track of the secrets you've unlocked using the to-do list.
[*] Feel free to start a discussion and help each other find them!
[/list]

notes.title: Mac, Linux and SteamOS Update
notes.content:
- Game now supports Mac, Linux and SteamOS play
- Typos, fixes and consistency improvements in various areas.
- The todo list on the main menu closes slightly faster, instead of having a small delay.
- I've also fixed a couple of instances of misplaced eyes or bodies in the artwork, the two mainly being Lily in the lab and Melody in the music studio. 

Just a small update that added functionality to these additional operating systems. I have personally been unable to test if they work, so fingers crossed, lemme know how it all works out. 
I'll continue to fix issues whenever they're found so everyone can have the best Friendship with Benefits experience possible. 

Thank you everyone for such an incredible launch. You can read here to see my plans for the next update: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1299370/discussions/0/3006676913242852078/
